# Final Execution Plan — File-by-File

> The Awtsmoos renews the world, yet every vessel needs a seam; architecture gives the many files one tested, living dream.  
> Awtsmoos.com will speak in scenes where shape and soul align; the code stays small, the contract clear, the proof in measured time.

## Slice One — Canonical Movie Domain

Create only new files under `libs/awtsmoos-procedural-core/src/core/movie/` unless a fresh collision check shows another agent has claimed the namespace.

1. `MovieKinds.js` — stable layer/transition/easing constants.
2. `MovieMath.js` — finite/clamp/lerp/easing helpers.
3. `MovieKeyframe.js` — normalize keyframe objects.
4. `MovieTransform.js` — normalize portable visual transforms.
5. `MovieLayer.js` — normalize timed semantic layers.
6. `MovieScene.js` — normalize scenes and derived end time.
7. `MovieDocument.js` — schema version, seed, dimensions, scenes, duration.
8. `MovieTimelineEvaluator.js` — find active scene/layers and evaluate keyframed state.
9. `MovieFeatureCatalog.js` — AI-readable feature vocabulary.
10. `MovieCapabilityPlanner.js` — native/fallback/unsupported planning.
11. `MovieValidation.js` — structural/timing/capability/coverage diagnostics.
12. `MovieCoverage.js` — count scene/layer/camera/semantic feature breadth.
13. `MovieAssetIntent.js` — portable procedural asset request.
14. `MovieAssetCatalog.js` — map movie intents to existing core capabilities by stable names/paths.
15. `MovieAiCompiler.js` — high-level intent/beat sheet to canonical scenes.
16. `index.js` — movie-local exports.

## Slice Two — Shared Awtsmoos UI

Create `libs/awtsmoos-ui/` with:

1. `package.json` — ESM package metadata.
2. `src/core/AwtsmoosUiSafety.js` — allowlists and safe normalization.
3. `src/core/AwtsmoosUiNode.js` — recipe node normalization.
4. `src/core/AwtsmoosUiBindings.js` — named action/value lookup.
5. `src/core/AwtsmoosUiCompiler.js` — recursive DOM materialization.
6. `src/tokens/AwtsmoosUiTokens.js` — mobile-first token object and CSS-variable helper.
7. `src/presets/AwtsmoosStudioRecipe.js` — reusable app-shell structure.
8. `src/index.js` — library exports.
9. `test/AwtsmoosUiCompiler.test.mjs` — DOM-free normalization/safety tests; browser compiler exercised later in app smoke.

## Slice Three — Awtsmoos Studio

Create `apps/awtsmoos-studio/`:

1. `index.html` — tiny boot document.
2. `src/main.js` — app bootstrap.
3. `src/app/AwtsmoosStudioState.js` — observable mutable studio state.
4. `src/app/AwtsmoosStudioApp.js` — composition/controller.
5. `src/movie/AwtsmoosStudioMovie.js` — load/validate/coverage facade.
6. `src/movie/AwtsmoosStudioPlayback.js` — rAF playback + scrub/pause semantics.
7. `src/render/CanvasLayerRenderer.js` — dispatch by semantic kind.
8. `src/render/CanvasShapeRenderer.js` — rect/circle/line/arrow/star/polygon/path.
9. `src/render/CanvasTextRenderer.js` — kinetic/tutorial/title text.
10. `src/render/CanvasCharacterRenderer.js` — stylized articulated people fallback.
11. `src/render/CanvasParticleRenderer.js` — deterministic seeded particles.
12. `src/render/CanvasChartRenderer.js` — bars/line/donut semantic charts.
13. `src/render/CanvasWorldRenderer.js` — perspective-style 3D intent fallback/world primitives.
14. `src/render/CanvasMovieRenderer.js` — scene/camera canvas composition.
15. `src/render/HybridRendererProfile.js` — explicit native/fallback capability report.
16. `src/ui/AwtsmoosStudioUiRecipe.js` — concrete shared-UI recipe.
17. `src/demo/createThreeMinuteMovie.js` — exactly 180 seconds, at least 12 scenes.
18. `src/demo/threeMinuteScenesA.js` and `threeMinuteScenesB.js` if needed to keep files under 120 lines.
19. `src/styles/studio.css` split further if line count grows.
20. `test/threeMinuteMovie.test.mjs` — duration/coverage/camera/features.

## Slice Four — Legacy Studio Adapters

After refreshing status, create new files only where paths remain free:

- Animator adapter translating canonical scene/layer concepts to Animator film/world intent and declaring 3D-rich capabilities.
- Nesher adapter translating canonical tracks/scenes into NLE project intent and declaring export/audio/effects capabilities.
- Mitzvah adapter translating 2D object/canvas layers.
- Video Editor adapter translating timeline clips/tracks.
- Slides adapter translating text/shape/image/chart/tutorial scenes into slide-like elements.

Wire entrypoints only if they are clean or the exact full-file rewrite can preserve concurrent changes. Otherwise expose tested adapters without destructive wiring and record the integration boundary.

## Slice Five — Real Three-Minute Render / Export

1. Use canonical proof movie as source of truth.
2. Prefer an existing local proven exporter if it can consume deterministic frames without invasive dirty-file changes.
3. Otherwise create an isolated export tool under the new Awtsmoos Studio app that renders the canonical movie to frame images or a browser capture, then muxes with local `ffmpeg` when available.
4. Probe output with `ffprobe` and assert duration close to 180 seconds.
5. Save proof media under the new app's `proof/` directory, not in legacy app artifact folders.

## Slice Six — Tests and Verification

- `node --check` every new JS file.
- Node unit tests for core/UI/app fixtures.
- import smoke tests for movie core and adapters.
- line-count audit and tab-indentation audit.
- static server for `geelooy` or app root.
- desktop browser open, console logs, play/scrub/scene interactions.
- mobile viewport open and touch-sized layout inspection.
- screenshot evidence if useful.
- export/probe evidence.
- read all touched files.
- write post-implementation delta, verification, remaining-work, and handoff artifacts.

## Write Discipline

Every source file is a full new write or a full rewrite after fresh read. No partial replacements. New executable files begin with B"H / Boruch Hashem / Blessed is He comments and a rhyming Awtsmoos/Awtsmoos.com JSDoc. Tabs only for indentation. Split before 120 lines rather than compressing comments or code.
